name: isoZero_isoAdd'_
statement: A} (e : shiftFunctor C a ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ shiftFunctor D a) : isoAdd' (zero_add a) (isoZero F A) e = e

name: isoAdd'_assoc
statement: A} (ea : shiftFunctor C a ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ shiftFunctor D a) (eb : shiftFunctor C b ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ shiftFunctor D b) (ec : shiftFunctor C c ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ shiftFunctor D c) (hab : a + b = ab) (hbc : b + c = bc) (h : a + b + c = abc) : isoAdd' (show ab + c = abc by rwa [← hab]) (isoAdd' hab ea eb) ec = isoAdd' (show a + bc = abc by grind) ea (isoAdd' hbc eb ec)

have_tree.body: NatTrans.naturality_2 ec.hom ((shiftFunctorAdd' C a b ab hab).app X)

name: map_shiftFunctorComm_hom_app
statement: C) (a b : B) : F.map ((shiftFunctorComm C a b).hom.app X) = (F.commShiftIso b).hom.app (X⟦a⟧) ≫ ((F.commShiftIso a).hom.app X)⟦b⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorComm D a b).hom.app (F.obj X) ≫ ((F.commShiftIso b).inv.app X)⟦a⟧' ≫ (F.commShiftIso a).inv.app (X⟦b⟧)

name: map_shiftFunctorCompIsoId_hom_app
statement: C) (a b : A) (h : a + b = 0) : F.map ((shiftFunctorCompIsoId C a b h).hom.app X) = (F.commShiftIso b).hom.app (X⟦a⟧) ≫ ((F.commShiftIso a).hom.app X)⟦b⟧' ≫ (shiftFunctorCompIsoId D a b h).hom.app (F.obj X)

name: add
